sources.note: Town of Grand Isle Selectboard page (grandislevt.org): lists five Selectboard members with printed term expirations, all running past the March 2026 meeting: Jennifer Morway (Chair, to 2027), Aimee Cochran (Vice Chair, to 2028), Ron Bushway (to 2029 -- the seat filled in March 2026), Ellen Howrigan (to 2027), and Jeff Parizo (to 2028). The SOS directory publishes no Grand Isle roster; the town's own page governs and the factory concurs 5/5.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Town Clerk Contact Info' spreadsheet: lists Melissa Boutin as Grand Isle Town Clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Melissa Boutin as Grand Isle Town Clerk (January 2026).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Melissa Boutin as both Grand Isle Town Clerk and Town Treasurer (January 2026).
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Treasurers' Contact Info' spreadsheet: refers Grand Isle's treasurer contact to the Town Clerk.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists three Grand Isle justices of the peace: Susan Lawrence, AnnaMarie DeMars, and Howard DeMars.

jp_election.name: Town of Grand Isle Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the SOS listing names the three Grand Isle winners of the November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election. No Constable post is created (seat count unverifiable) and no Collector of Delinquent Taxes post (the treasurer is collector ex officio unless the town votes otherwise). Grand Isle drafted a town charter in August 2026 that is NOT adopted; the town is built under general law.
